entities.summary: Gary Dean Bergen was an American basketball player. He played collegiately for the University of Utah. Bergen was selected by the New York Knicks in the 1956 NBA draft. He played for the Knicks (1956–57) in the NBA for 6 games. Bergen died on July 27, 2010.
